mission.title: Veils
mission.description: Join Agent Pace in a meeting with Veil, the Cypherites' new leader.

npc.say: If the Cypherites become a liability, they will be eliminated.
The Cypherites have been a necessary method of control.

I will meet you there, rossapillola. We must expect Veil to be in a somewhat hostile mood, as she had not been aware of Cryptos' overwritten state until the damage resulting from Seraph's attack made it clear.
Cryptos' current status is unknown; he jacked out after the attack, and we have received no signal from him since. Seraph has been able to remove overwriting programs from other redpills and bluepills, but reports indicate that the process did not go as expected with Cryptos himself, whose overwriting process was much more involved.

Sorry, dearie. I've got some sleep to catch up on. Wouldn't want to be all grumpy tomorrow.
Tell your darling Agent Pace not to frown like that; I'm afraid it doesn't suit her at all.

phase.briefing:
Operative, a sudden attack by Seraph has crippled the Cypherite leader, Cryptos.
It is time that we discuss the...purpose of the Cypherite organization.

enter.say:
They'd better have a damn good--
No... You know what? I don't even want to go there.

talk.say:
Operative, the Zionite known as Cryptos was overwritten by a Machine program years ago. This program's purpose was to form a group of humans dedicated to the task of preventing Zion from destabilizing the System by awakening more than the allotted 1% of the Matrix' population. At the beginning of the truce period, it was difficult for us to control these excess awakenings without causing an overreaction in Zion.
The group came to be known as the Cypherites. Under the overwritten Cryptos' leadership, they have been effective in reducing excess awakenings. However, Seraph's attack has disabled Cryptos, and revealed his Machine overwriting. This has led to a certain amount of...political fallout with Zion, and even among Cypherites. Agent Pace will describe your next task.

done.say:
...
Just...go talk to Pace. I'm sure she'll know how to make this make sense.

talk.say: {player}, with Cryptos out of action, his controller, Veil, has assumed active leadership of the Cypherites. Her behavior is unpredictable, and possibly based on an agenda of her own. It is vital that we meet with Veil and come to an understanding regarding the role of the Cypherites within the System. You and I will be going to see her immediately.

done.say: So Pace knew about this all along? Well, that's just great...

phase.briefing:
There are indications that some Cypherites, possibly at the instigation of Veil herself, have shown negative--even violent--reactions to the revelation of Cryptos' overwritten status.
While this is not, perhaps, overly surprising, it is necessary that the Cypherites as a group be brought under some degree of control. The most efficient means of achieving this is by coming to an agreement with Veil herself.
If this proves impossible, we will have to consider...alternate means.

enter.say:
Son of a--
Never thought I'd see the day when I'd almost consider sympathizing with Veil...
She's in there, along with Pace, another Machine program, and a couple Cypherites.

talk.say:
Veil was not been willing to converse, {player}. We may have to--
Oh!

done.say: The Cypherites are losing it! Don't let them hurt Pace!

Is Pace all right?
Great, and here I thought I was over her.
Look, now that Veil's muscle's out of the way, you'd better have a talk with that ingrate. She's lucky we didn't delete her a long time ago...

Thank you, tesoro!
I knew they were confused by recent events, but for them to react so violently...

objective.text: Do not let Agent Pace die

talk.say:
Oh, I see how it is, dearie. That's been made very clear.
Well, that's all I wanted to know. Ta! Be seeing you around, mm?

done.say:
Grr...
You know what I said earlier about almost sympathizing with her? Forget I said it.

phase.briefing:
I...see. Thank you, operative. Veil is proving...difficult to deal with, at least in part because she is clever enough not to commit herself to a direct confrontation. However, as long as she holds herself within certain limits, it is much more efficient to leave her in place until Cryptos can be restored, rather than further destabilizing their organization with another leadership change.
While you were meeting with Veil, another situation came to light. Commando programs have appeared nearby. This was not expected, as our network scans have shown no commando access points in the vicinity.
However, that is a concern to be addressed later. Your immediate task is the deletion of the commando programs.

enter.say:
Good. I could use a little carnage right about now.
I've got standard commando readings in there. That seems to be all that Gray's anticipating right now. I'm gonna get on the horn with him and see about getting a scan run for the Elites, though. I don't feel much like running into any more surprises today.

done.say: Now, what hole did those boot-lickers crawl out of?

phase.briefing:
Your operator has...informed us of the necessity of running a scan routine for Elite Commandos in the area.
The scan is running...
Signals detected. The target is marked.

enter.say: Damn right I informed him! Hah! Overwrite this...
There they are, the sneaky bastards!
Right on cue! What'd I tell ya?

objective.text: Kill all of the Elite Commandos

mission.finish:
The lack of any access point in the vicinity, coinciding with the presence of Merovingian Exile programs, is a doubly suspicious circumstance. Based on this data, it seems likely that the Merovingian is actively assisting the General with his troop movements. The Merovingian's fortune derives from his ability to transport programs in and out of the Matrix; moving the General's forces is well within his means. This is an important new factor in the General's equation.
{player}... I realize that the recent events involving Cryptos and the Cypherites have been...uncomfortable. What has been done has been done with the survival of the Matrix and all those within it as its primary goal. While the abruptness of the manner in which these steps were revealed has been regrettably traumatic, we have every confidence that the admirable judgment you have displayed in your capacity as an operative of the System will continue to serve you well.
